sentences.text: For floating-rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals and sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges.
The bank’s home-loan form says a pre-payment charge of 3% of principal outstanding applies on foreclosure or pre-payment.
